name: 陳政翰
objective:
本課程專注於培養學生在數位媒體製作領域的實務能力與創意表達，涵蓋影片剪輯、動態圖像設計及音效處理等核心技能。課程將使用達芬奇進行專業教學，並模擬真實的影片製作流程。學生將組成小型劇組，從劇本創作、分鏡設計到拍攝、後製，全方位參與短片製作專案。期末舉辦小型影展，呈現學生的創意成果與團隊協作能力。
This course focuses on developing practical skills and creative expression in digital media production. It covers core competencies such as video editing, motion graphics design, and audio processing using DaVinci Resolve. Students will form small production teams, simulating real-world film production workflows. From scriptwriting and storyboard creation to shooting and post-production, students will fully engage in a short film project. A mini film exhibition will be held at the end of the semester to showcase students’ creative achievements and teamwork.
schedule:
01	說明課程目標與短片製作流程，完成分組並安裝 DaVinci Resolve。
Introduce course objectives and the short film production workflow, form production teams, and install DaVinci Resolve.

02	認識 DaVinci Resolve 介面並進行基礎剪輯操作。
Become familiar with the DaVinci Resolve interface and perform basic editing operations.

03	學習剪輯節奏、字幕製作與基本轉場應用。
Learn editing rhythm, subtitle creation, and basic transition techniques.

04	了解調色基本概念並進行影像基礎修色。
Understand fundamental color correction concepts and apply basic color adjustments.

05	練習音畫同步與多機剪輯，提升敘事流暢度。
Practice audio-video synchronization and multicamera editing to enhance narrative flow.

06	認識 Fusion 與 Fairlight 的基本概念，建立完整後製觀念。
Introduce the basic concepts of Fusion and Fairlight to build an integrated post-production workflow.

07	進行劇本創作與分鏡腳本設計，完成拍攝前期規劃。
Develop scripts and storyboards to complete pre-production planning.

08	學習影像拍攝理論與器材操作，為實際拍攝做好準備。
Learn cinematography principles and equipment operation to prepare for filming.

09	影片拍攝

10	影片拍攝

Film Shooting (No Class)

12	影片拍攝
Film Shooting (No Class)

13	初剪與後製初探
First Cut and Initial Post-Production

14	初剪與後製初探
First Cut and Initial Post-Production

15	影片精修：後製與音效設計

17	最終剪輯與定稿
Final Editing and Fine-Tuning

18	期末影展與成果發表
Final Film Exhibition and Presentation
